sourceText:
Grilled Blue Cheese Bread
By: Curt
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:05pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup (½ stick) margarine or 1/4 cup Crumbled blue cheese
2 tablespoons Grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 loaf (1 lb.) French Bread

Preparation

1 Mix margarine and cheeses. Cut bread horizontally in half. Spread one cut side with cheese mixture. Top with remaining bread half. Wrap in heavy-duty aluminum foil. Grill bread 5 to 6 inches from medium coals about 6 minutes, turning once, until hot. 2 Yield: 8 Slices. 3 Grilled Pepper Cheese Slices: Omit Parmesan cheese. Substitute 1/2 cup shredded pepper Jack cheese for the blue cheese. Mix margarine and cheese. 4 Grilled Herb-Lemon Cheese Slices: Omit blue cheese and Parmesan cheese. 5 Mix margarine, 2 tsp. chopped fresh herbs or 1/2 tsp. dried herbs, 1 tsp. lemon juice and dash of salt.
